name: year-card
description: A year in big serif type, a framed archive photo tilted on a dark blueprint sheet, and a yellow tag naming the subject. Like "1952 / DE HAVILLAND COMET" in the reference reel. Dimension lines draw themselves around the drawing; an optional `blueprint` line drawing (dark lines on a light ground, shown as thin light lines) replaces the generic drawing.
useWhen: the speaker names a year, decade or date for an event
an invention, building or machine is introduced with the year it appeared
a before and after, where the year anchors the scene
